description: This file contains the implementation of a Renderer for Android's OpenGL ES graphics, specifically rendering a static triangle with texture mapping. It defines the StaticTriangleRenderer class which manages OpenGL lifecycle callbacks and draws a textured triangle, along with inner classes for triangle geometry and texture loading.

classes.name: StaticTriangleRenderer
classes.description: An OpenGL ES renderer handling surface creation, changes, and frame drawing, responsible for rendering a textured triangle in an Android GLSurfaceView.

classes.name: StaticTriangleRenderer.Triangle
classes.description: Inner class representing the geometry of a triangle, including vertex and texture buffers and a draw method.

classes.name: StaticTriangleRenderer.TextureLoader
classes.description: Interface for loading textures into OpenGL.

classes.name: StaticTriangleRenderer.RobotTextureLoader
classes.description: Implementation of TextureLoader that loads a robot image resource as a texture.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL ES environment settings, creates texture assets, and prepares the renderer state.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Draws a frame, clears buffers, applies transformations, and renders the textured triangle.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts the viewport and projection parameters on surface dimension changes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Common initialization routine called by constructors to set up rendering.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a bitmap as an OpenGL texture.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the triangle shape with the current OpenGL context.
